known_deviations: This is a protocol-1.5 post-unsealing corrected diagnostic, not pristine blind-validation evidence.
The canonical sky temperature was not copied to native object WeatherState, so v6 skipped opaque longwave exchange while retaining shortwave absorption.
Pooled RMSE, pooled bias, per-zone RMSE, and four-row input completeness fail; thermal conservation, no-fallback, and deterministic-repeat checks pass.
The incomplete handoff is retained here as rejected evidence and corrected only in a separately versioned run.
